{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Now, restrict to loyal customers only, without filtering by status
df_loyal = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted (converted = 1)
total_loyal = len(df_loyal)
converted_loyal = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = converted_loyal / total_loyal

print(f"Total loyal customers (all statuses): {total_loyal}")
print(f"Converted loyal customers: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")"}
